content.text:
No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant exists anywhere in the agreement. The Client covenants (§ 8) are limited to legal compliance, notification, access limitation, credit data use, content representations, and spamming; the confidentiality section (§ 10) contains no personnel restriction. Searches for "solicit", "employ", "induce", "hire", "recruit", "personnel", and "engage" returned only spam, indemnity, and trademark-search references. The one "Non-Competition Agreement" reference in § 8(d) governs Credit Data use limitations, not hiring of personnel.

Absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer matches our preferred position exactly, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: b. Notification. Client shall not represent that loan underwriting decisions related to loans originated by using the Interface are in any way made by TrueLink
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement covenant binding Mortgage Logic.com (Client). Section 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) is limited to compliance with laws, notification, limitation on access, credit data licensing, content representations, and spamming; Section 10 (Confidentiality) imposes only information-protection duties with no personnel restriction. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ", "induce", "hire", "recruit", "personnel", "staff", and "engage" surfaced only unsolicited-email (spam), indemnity, and trademark-search provisions. The sole "Non-Competition Agreement" cross-reference in Section 8(d) limits TrueLink's use of Credit Data and does not restrict Client's hiring. This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, so no edit is required; if TrueLink later proposes one, we would accept only the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from end of involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire).
